name: The Reef at Atlantis
insider_take: Where ocean views meet effortless luxury in the heart of Paradise Island's most iconic resort destination.
whats_special: The Reef at Atlantis sits on the quieter, more sophisticated side of the massive Atlantis complex, offering suite-style accommodations with full access to the resort's legendary aquariums, water parks, and marine habitats. This adults-focused tower features some of the Caribbean's most stunning ocean vistas and direct beach access to pristine Cove Beach.
pro_tip: Book a suite on the upper floors facing east for unobstructed sunrise views over the turquoise waters, and use the complimentary shuttle to explore all of Atlantis without the crowds of the main towers.
dont_miss: Swimming with dolphins at Dolphin Cay, exploring the massive Dig aquarium ruins, and experiencing the thrilling Leap of Faith waterslide through a shark-filled lagoon. The nearby Glass House restaurant offers world-class dining with panoramic ocean views.
pros: Exclusive all-suite accommodations with stunning ocean views
Full access to Atlantis resort amenities and attractions
Private beach access and upscale dining options
Sophisticated adult-oriented atmosphere within family resort
cons: Premium pricing compared to other resort areas
Limited on-site dining venues within The Reef itself
